CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qms_mail_claim_batch_v3(p_limit integer, p_lease_seconds integer, p_run_nonce uuid, p_issued_at bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, claim_token uuid, tipo text, destinatario text, folio text, estado text, numero_oficio text, public_tracking jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT c.id,c.claim_token,c.tipo,c.destinatario,c.folio,c.estado,c.numero_oficio,o.public_tracking
    FROM public.qms_mail_claim_batch_v2(p_limit,p_lease_seconds,p_run_nonce,p_issued_at) c
    JOIN public.queja_mail_outbox o ON o.id=c.id;
$function$
